description: Korean VAT-exempt business status report (사업장현황신고, 소득세법 제78조): due Feb 10 of the next year (next business day if a holiday), deemed filed if VAT returns covered all revenue (mixed businesses report the exempt part), personal-service freelancers included; the 0.5% penalty on unreported revenue applies only to medical, veterinary and pharmacy businesses (제81조의3, 시행령 제147조의2). Does not say the May income tax return replaces it. Estimate only; no filing.
